warnings: Some end-date-active notices start after the spend window. Listed for traceability; these future notices are excluded from matching and spend-vs-award.
contracts.caveat: contracts.csv holds published *notices*, not a contract register. It holds awards published on Contracts Finder in roughly the last five years. A contract awarded earlier (e.g. long-running waste or highways contracts), one advertised only on Find a Tender, a framework call-off recorded under another buyer, or an exempt placement will have no notice here. "No notice found" is therefore an indicator to check against the council's contract register, never evidence of off-contract spend.
